maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is subscription payroll, HR, tax and time software plus managed services, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private employers, mostly small and mid-sized businesses, paying for AsureCentral payroll, HR and AsureWorks managed services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Past acquisitions built the platform, but recent growth comes mainly from selling AsureCentral, AsureWorks and related products.

mission_critical.reason: Payroll, tax filing and HR compliance run through AsureCentral and AsureWorks; switching risks pay errors, tax penalties and migration disruption.

notes: Asure acquired many companies in earlier years; the serial-acquirer answer reflects its current mainly organic growth.
